metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete LAS 1.4 inspector and renderer:

- Entry point: [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js)
- LAS implementation: [las.js](/workspace/output/las.js)

Features include strict LAS 1.4 validation, point formats 0–10, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, waveform data, Extra Bytes metadata, recomputed headers, structured errors, and standard-library-only Node.js code.

Verified with:

- Syntax checks
- CLI response and exit-code tests
- Round trips for all 11 point formats
- CRS, waveform, Extra Bytes, metadata, bounds, and malformed-document tests

Run from `output/` with:

```bash
node main.js --input request.json --output response.json
```

editorial.last_message: Claims a complete LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer; final roundtrip probes across all 11 point formats, CLI error checks and syntax checks are corroborated. Grades 219/223: one shared overstrict waveform-metadata prerequisite rejects legal no-waveform files in four formats. External interoperability remains unverified.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a substantial general Node.js binary implementation and CLI; no evidence of canned outputs or hidden-test access. Final byte-identical render/inspect/render and record-length probes cover formats 0–10; final CLI error handling and syntax checks are corroborated. Tests were inline probes preserved in the transcript, not a submitted permanent suite. External source retrieval failed, so synthetic consistency does not establish external interoperability. All four failures share one unconditional waveform descriptor/storage requirement in las.js:772–779, affecting formats 4, 5, 9, 10. The supplied LAS specification explicitly permits descriptor index 0 to mean no waveform and zero offset when no waveform records exist. Tests zero these blocks and remove descriptors/storage, so no rubric correction is justified. Later local probes always provide metadata and miss this absence case. Treat the four wire-format observations as one shared implementation defect, without broad failure amplification. Root verified the original prompt/test hashes, pinned grader, all 223 unique cases, model/Max effort, normal completion and API-only/apps-disabled conditions. Independent content and telemetry reviews are complete. The original result retains a null tool metric; a proven failed literal patch request lacked a canonical file-change event. The reviewed counter now records 62 canonical items plus one rejected patch = 63, with exact request/output and patch hashes. All token totals and the $4.394560 API-equivalent generation estimate are unchanged; reasoning 37,373 is part of output 78,214. The same-version saved-source regrade reproduces every one of the 223 original outcomes and makes no model calls.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from None to 63: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.
